context_requirements: Functional NR5A1 (SF-1) expression and an active NR5A1-dependent transcriptional program
Cell lineage with endogenous NR5A1 activity, such as adrenal cortical, gonadal, or pituitary cells
Presence of NR5A1 coactivators and target gene enhancers
falsifiers: Reproducible concentration-dependent changes in NR5A1 target genes or steroidogenic pathway genes in any of the nine cell lines
Consistent transcriptional signature shared across multiple cell lines at 6 h or 24 h
Evidence of NR5A1 expression and activity in these lines that is modulated by the drug
